title: Mindtrip: free AI travel companion
text: Mindtrip advertises a free travel app with personalised itineraries, group collaboration, maps, recommendations and booking receipt organisation. Implication: a paid generic itinerary assistant competes against an established free bundle. This is a vendor feature claim, not proof of customer demand.

title: Wanderlog: free collaborative planning
text: Wanderlog says its core planning experience remains free, without limiting trips or the number of collaborators. A paid Pro tier adds premium features. Implication: group collaboration alone is not sufficient differentiation. This source does not establish current Pro pricing.

title: TripIt Pro: US$49 per year
text: TripIt advertises Pro at US$49 per year, with flight alerts, alternative flight options and other practical travel assistance. This is an annual USD competitor benchmark, not a GBP per-trip equivalent or measured willingness to pay for our proposed product.
